newsitem.title: UK: BBC sees Labour majority of 203 after 24 results.
newsitem.headline: BBC sees Labour majority of 203 after 24 results.

text.p: The first 24 results in the British election suggest an average swing to the main opposition Labour party of 9.6 percent, the BBC said on Friday.
If this swing is replicated across the country, Labour will form the next government with a majority of 203 seats in the 659 seat parliament, it said.
By just after midnight GMT, Labour had won 57 seats, the Liberal Democrats four, and the Conservatives one.
The exit polls and early results suggested Labour was poised to return to power after 18 years in opposition with a huge landslide victory on a scale not seen since 1832.
